notes: PROJECTION AND NET WORTH NOW GENUINELY OPEN ON THE CURRENT MONTH. The v2026.05.13.03 note said this was done and verified, but it did not work on a real load. launchDashboard, which runs on every app entry, wrote horizonStart into budgetStart and horizonEnd into valuationDate whenever they were empty, and kept any saved value otherwise. Both renderers' current-month fallbacks therefore never ran: the earlier verification called the renderers with those fields empty, a code path that does not occur after launchDashboard. Reproduced on v2026.11.11.01 with a returning user's saved dates (sheet 2026-05 to 2027-04, Net Worth 2036-12): the sheet opened on 2026-05 and Net Worth on 2036-12. FIX: launchDashboard now sets both to the current month ONCE per page load, falling back to the horizon start if today is outside the horizon. The sheet keeps the width of the last window used (12 months if none), shifted to start now. A month picked on either page holds for the rest of the session, including after re-running the wizard; the next load opens on the current month again. The sheet's Default 1-year button now resets to the current month for 12 months instead of the horizon start. One helper, _defaultOpenMonth, is used by launchDashboard, both renderers' fallbacks and the reset button. Dashboard unchanged. VERIFIED in headless Chromium through the real launchDashboard path, with the old build as a control: old build opens the sheet at 2026-05 and Net Worth at 2036-12; new build opens both at 2026-11, the sheet window ends 2027-10, a picked Net Worth month of 2030-06 and sheet start of 2028-01 survive a wizard re-run, reset returns 2026-11 to 2027-10, no page errors. Chart.js was stubbed because the test machine has no network. ENGINE UNCHANGED FROM v2026.11.11.01: engine output with no scenarios is identical to v2026.05.13.03 and the 27 revise-scenario assertions still pass. REVISE SCENARIO STATUS: the engine is built (see v2026.11.11.01: category, emi and invest changes; later from wins; deleted categories and closed EMIs ignored; newAmount 0 honoured).
